note: Written on 2026-10-24 at the revision stage, AFTER the runs. It reconstructs, from the pipeline record, the claims map as changed at the check stage (2026-10-23 11:23-11:24, scripts check_stage/verify_map.py and check_stage/other_metrics.py). That version was never saved as a file at the time. claims.json (mtime 2026-10-23 11:21:26) is the original pre-registration and is left unchanged. The check-stage changes were made before any of our scores existed, but after comparing both definitions of the corrected average on the authors' per-assay tables. The SE values below were re-printed on 2026-10-24 by re-running the two check_stage scripts, which read only the authors' tables.
supersedes_in_report: claims.json fields corrected_average_primary_literal, corrected_average_secondary_code, tolerance_rule, and the tolerances of C3, C4, C5
changes_vs_claims_json: Primary corrected average: code definition (performance_DMS_benchmarks.py at PG_v1.3: assays averaged per (UniProt_ID, function type), then per function type, then the mean of the 5). The literal A.5.1 reading becomes an alternative.
Tolerance: 1 bootstrap SE of the authors' own corrected average under the code definition, 10,000 resamples of (UniProt_ID, type) units within each function type, seed 0, rounded to 3 decimals.
C6-C9 added: the other ESM-1b metrics of Table 2.

definitions.corrected_average_primary_code: performance_DMS_benchmarks.py lines 361-369 at PG_v1.3. Authors' per-assay values give ESM-1b 0.3941, 8M 0.2257, 35M 0.3208, 150M 0.3868, 650M 0.4138; all 5 paper values at 3 decimals.
definitions.corrected_average_alternative_literal: Paper A.5.1: plain mean of assays inside each function type, then mean of the 5. ESM-1b 0.3982, 8M 0.2244, 35M 0.3196, 150M 0.3895, 650M 0.4184.
definitions.tolerance_rule: 1 non-parametric bootstrap SE of the authors' own corrected average, code definition, 10,000 resamples of (UniProt_ID, type) units within each type, seed 0, rounded to 3 decimals.
